definition: taking in the world with your eyes
description: An old-fashioned optician's room with wooden panelling and a green and white checked floor. A young woman with long wavy blonde hair, in a lilac jumper, sits in a leather examination chair wearing round metal test glasses. Her mouth is open in delight as she points at a small blue and yellow bird on a branch of red berries outside the window; the bird flies away and she keeps pointing and smiling. A man in a white shirt stands beside her holding a small lens and smiles.

taps.phrase: to point out of the window
